integrity: The infinite result is proved symbolically from the published Pell parametrization. The finite verifier is used only to check normalization, initial values, and arithmetic identities; it is not treated as proof of an infinite assertion.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts square-exception parameters only; identifying every non-fundamental parameter with a square-exception still requires the discriminant hypothesis in the source.
No effective optimal constant is claimed for the \(O(1)\) counting remainder.
The merged ordering by absolute value across positive and negative parameters is not classified.
title: Logarithmic counting and interlacing of the cubic square-exception set
